messages:
Carmen: Re-requesting review — addressed the comments from earlier and added a regression test for the routing edge-case. PTAL when you have a sec. I also applied a small defensive nil-check that Noah suggested and squashed the fixups into one commit. Prefer to squash (small churn). Need two approvals to merge; aiming for a canary tonight.
Noah: Thanks — skimmed. Left one tiny comment about the allocator call path (see inline). Can you add a focused unit test for the nil path? Otherwise looks good, +1 for squash.
Li: Added the unit test and a short assertion for the allocator path, pushed as a tiny follow-up (squashed). Re-ran the integration locally, passes here. PTAL @Noah @Olivia.
Carmen: pushed the squashed commit including Li's test and updated the changelog under "behavioral changes". CI is green except one flaky on macos-latest for TestBatchRouter — I couldn't reproduce locally. Log excerpt:```
--- FAIL: TestBatchRouter (0.12s)
    batch_router_test.go:87: expected 3 requests, got 2
    === RUN   TestBatchRouter/handles-batching-timing
    panic: send on closed channel (tested)
```
ci-bot: CI job macos-latest (build 4512) failed on TestBatchRouter — re-run queued.
Olivia: I looked through the test and the new assertions — this is fine from a product perspective. Approved. Could you add a single-line note in release notes about the routing change so SRE knows to watch for increased prefix-matching?
Noah: Approved from my side as well.
merge-ops: Received request to queue for canary tonight. ETA: scheduling in the 21:00 UTC canary slot, will report back when queued.
Carmen: Thanks all — will watch the canary and monitor logs for the first hour. If the macos flake persists in CI I'll open a follow-up to isolate it to the runner and skip as needed.
Olivia: Thanks, Carmen. :thumbsup:
